title: Winona A NDE 7841
content: This was an extreme abuse scene with the perpetrator in control. He did not notice that I had stopped breathing and was beginning to convulse. I was unable to breath and my heart was slowing down. Although I was not moving, I was still very aware of what was happening around me. Next to me on my right side was a presence. They were similar to the 'light beings' I had seen when I was three years old. But this time, the presence turned into a likeness of Jesus. He stood next to me and looked in my eyes. Then he touched/rubbed my right cheek. I immediately was able to breath and was free of pain and fear. I was still with the perpetrator, on a table, but knew that nothing he could do could destroy this one-ness. This connection with something so much larger than his abuse, hate, and lies. The Jesus presence then asked me to 'see.' I saw myself in a shamanic journey that I had done what I was around 40 years old. I was standing in the midst of complete and total light. The white light doesn't really come from anywhere and is bright but not at all bright. It was all encompassing, fully surrounded me, and was completely loving. This light and love stayed with me briefly after the Jesus presence left. I looked at the perpetrator and he realized something had happened; that he no longer had 'control' and that I was not afraid. He was infuriated and became more violent, but it was bearable. That part of me can still share that loving energy somehow. I had that knowing it is or can be ok 'at the end' and beyond.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: The presence turned into a likeness of Jesus, stood next to her, looked in her eyes, and touched/rubbed her right cheek.
arrival.other_being_detail: A presence similar to 'light beings' she had seen when she was three years old.

environment.environment_other_detail: Complete and total white light that 'doesn't really come from anywhere' and is 'bright but not at all bright,' all-encompassing and completely loving.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Extreme abuse scene; stopped breathing, began to convulse; unable to breathe and heart was slowing down.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Healing touch enabling breathing; vision prompted by Jesus presence ('see') of being in total light during a shamanic journey around age 40.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No tunnel/OBE described; encounter with presence/Jesus occurred while still on a table with the perpetrator; then a vision of being in total light.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: She remained physically present with the perpetrator while experiencing the presence/Jesus and subsequent light/vision.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience occurred during ongoing abuse without leaving the body; Jesus presence physically touched/rubbed her cheek and she immediately could breathe; Jesus asked her to 'see' and she saw herself in a later-life shamanic journey standing in total light.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Then he touched/rubbed my right cheek. I immediately was able to breath and was free of pain and fear.”; “I saw myself… standing in the midst of complete and total light.”; “The white light doesn't really come from anywhere and is bright but not at all bright.”; “nothing he could do could destroy this one-ness.”
